The '''Crabshell Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be obtained as a reward from [[Gil]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after completing the Monster Eradication Goal of killing 60 [[Rock Crab|Rock Crabs]]. Killing [[Lava Crab|Lava Crabs]] and [[Iridium Crab|Iridium Crabs]] are also counted towards the total of 60 kills. After that, it can be purchased from Marlon for {{Price|15000}}.

The Crabshell Ring provides +5 [[Defense]].

Equipping a second Crabshell Ring provides a further +5 Defense.<ref name="stacking" />

==Dyeing==
Crabshell Ring can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==References==
<references>
